The '''Praxis Mk. I turbo speeder''', more commonly known as the '''Jedi turbo speeder''', was a model of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
